objective: Eliminate model-transcribed quotation errors in semantic insertion metadata while preserving exact source identities and conservative scope.
hypothesis: Selecting existing source-line IDs, with canonical source bytes copied by the runtime, should be more reliable than free-text quotation generation. Titles/summaries remain unverified retrieval metadata.
selection_evidence: R82 passed4/8 raw structural outputs; the post-hoc r83 decoder binds7/8. Packet6 includes an invented quotation, so envelope repair alone is insufficient. Do not drop the quote or rewrite the original result.

source_policy.selection: Eligible trajectory ranks5 through8 in each domain, same source-order/first-changed-transition criterion as r81. New8 source IDs disjoint from r81; not an independent QA confirmation set, because all200 trajectories are shared source.
source_policy.rendering: Complete original projected trees split into physical lines with before:L<n>/after:L<n> IDs. Joining rendered line texts with newline reconstructs the exact original tree. Nothing is clipped.
source_policy.line_eligibility: Only8–300-character complete source lines can be cited. Long/empty lines remain in the model input but are ineligible. Unknown or duplicate selected IDs fail. Explicit IDs disambiguate repeated text without guessing positions.
source_policy.output: Closed JSON record_kind/outcome/title/summary/source_line_ids. Outcome must be unverified;2–8 existing IDs, at least one per phase. Runtime mechanically copies exact source lines with SHA, UTF8 byte offsets and physical line numbers.
source_policy.metadata_projection: Allow one complete enclosing JSON fence. Cap only retrieval title/summary with explicit truncation flags and retain original raw response. No model quotation transcription, fuzzy matching, invented source repair, success inference or certified semantics.

prospective_pilot.admission: All8 prompts admitted before any generation. Stop uncertain transport; no replay, replacements or post-hoc source cohort changes. Known-invalid outputs remain failed in8-case denominator.
prospective_pilot.output_gate: All8 outputs have complete known usage, conservative schema, both phases and exact canonical source-byte binding. This qualifies structural construction only.
prospective_pilot.next: Independent source/usage audit and semantic usefulness review. A reusable insertion index and all26 exposed source-reach audit are still prerequisites to any QA reader/transfer or140-question confirmation.

construction_boundary.authority: Standing owner private G03 research and all GLM approval; D65 candidate only.
construction_boundary.product_frontier: Bounded line-handle renderer/selector and source-only insertion construction.
construction_boundary.operational_lane: WSL sanitized public projection/evidence; unchanged fixed VPS relay and accepted private socket prefix. No new install, screenshot processing, credential transfer or raw dataset staging.
deferred_residue: Reusable insertion index covering complete workflows
